Basic Usage
===========

This page summarizes the core docking options and everyday workflows in **PandaDock v5.0**.

Core Docking Options (``pandadock dock``)
-----------------------------------------

**Inputs & Grid Box:**

* ``-r, --receptor PATH``: Prepared receptor PDB file (without the old co-crystal ligand blocking the pocket)
* ``-l, --ligand PATH``: Ligand file (SDF, MOL2, or PDB)
* ``-g, --grid-config PATH``: Grid box JSON generated by ``pandadock-gridbox``
* ``--center X Y Z`` and ``--box DX DY DZ``: Manual box center and dimensions in Å (alternative to ``-g``)

**Scoring & Hardware:**

* ``-s, --scoring``: ``vina`` (default), ``vinardo``, or ``physics_based``
* ``-n, --num-poses``: Maximum ranked binding modes returned (default: ``20``)
* ``-e, --exhaustiveness``: Independent Monte Carlo trajectories (auto-scales 8–32 with ligand flexibility)
* ``-j, --workers``: Parallel CPU threads across trajectories (e.g. ``--workers 4``)
* ``--device``: ``cpu`` (default), ``cuda`` (NVIDIA GPU), or ``mps`` (Apple Silicon GPU) with ``--n-chains 512``
* ``--seed``: Fixed integer seed for reproducible runs
* ``--fast``: Reduced sampling for quick smoke tests

**v5.0 Pocket Physics & Medicinal Chemistry:**

* ``--waters``: Structural pocket water protocol — ``strip`` (default), ``keep``, or ``displace``
* ``--restraint``: Repeatable smooth flat-bottom restraint (e.g. ``A:ZN:301:ZN<2.3:donor`` or ``point:X,Y,Z<2.5:aromatic``)
* ``--enumerate-states --ph 7.4``: Automatic pH protonation, tautomer & stereoisomer enumeration
* ``--sample-rings``: Sample non-aromatic ring conformers (ETKDGv3)
* ``--rescoring mmgbsa``: Differential 12 Å pocket MM-GBSA rescoring
* ``--weights-file PATH``: Per-target calibrated weights from ``pandadock calibrate``
* ``--export-md openmm|gromacs|both``: Export top pose as a ready-to-run MD package

Everyday Recipes
----------------

Multi-Core CPU Docking
^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

.. code-block:: bash

   pandadock dock -r receptor.pdb -l ligand.sdf -g box.json \
                  --scoring vina --workers 4 --seed 42 -o run_cpu/

Metalloprotein with Bridging Waters & Restraint
^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

.. code-block:: bash

   pandadock dock -r 3hs4_zn_hoh.pdb -l azm.sdf \
                  --center -5.3 -0.5 14.8 --box 20 20 20 \
                  --waters displace --restraint "A:ZN:301:ZN<2.3:donor" \
                  --rescoring mmgbsa --export-md both -o run_3hs4/

High-Throughput Batched GPU Virtual Screening
^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

.. code-block:: bash

   pandadock screen -r receptor.pdb -l library.sdf -g box.json \
                    --device cuda --n-chains 128 --top 50 -o screen_out/

Getting Help
------------

.. code-block:: bash

   pandadock --help
   pandadock dock --help
   pandadock series --help
   pandadock covalent --help
   pandadock-prepare --help
   pandadock-gridbox --help
